name: Inkwell
description: A black, editorial changelog: a large serif title, a cover picture over every release, summaries with the authors’ faces, a white-dotted rail — and a centred release page with code in tabs, video and a link to the page as Markdown.
features: Index layout: gutter, white rail dots, the change type under the date
16:9 cover picture above every release title
Summaries with the authors as avatars
Search and an email-popover subscribe on the title row
Release page: centred head, date above the title, “More releases”, Markdown actions
Sample release with a code group and a self-hosted video
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

attrs.heading: Stay in the loop
attrs.body: Product updates, once a month. Unsubscribe any time.

posts.title: Introducing email templates
posts.markdown:
Write an email once, as a component, and send it from any language with its variables filled in. Templates are versioned, previewed and tested before they reach an inbox.

## Added

:::video{src="/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000010b" poster="/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000010c"}:::

- A template gallery to start from: welcome, receipt, password reset.
- Preview with test data, in light and dark mail clients.

Send one from the SDK:

:::codeGroup{syncKey="lang"}
```js title="Node.js"
await client.emails.send({ template: "welcome", to: "you@example.com", data: { name: "Ada" } });
```
```python title="Python"
client.emails.send(template="welcome", to="you@example.com", data={"name": "Ada"})
```
```sh title="cURL"
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/emails -d '{"template":"welcome","to":"you@example.com"}'
```
:::

posts.title: Receive email with inbound routes
posts.markdown:
Point a domain's MX record at us and every message it receives arrives at your webhook as JSON, attachments included.

## Added

- Routes by address, by subdomain or catch-all.
- Spam scores and authentication results on every message.

posts.title: Logs that load in a blink
posts.markdown:
The logs page now opens instantly on accounts with millions of messages, and filters apply as you type.

## Changed

- Search by recipient, subject or message ID.
- Export the current filter as CSV.

posts.title: Scoped API keys
posts.markdown:
API keys can now be limited to sending, to one domain, or to read-only access, and every key shows when it was last used.

## Upgrading

Full-access keys created before this release keep working until the date below, then become send-only. Create a scoped key for each service and rotate the old one out; the keys page marks every key that still needs it.

## Security

- Keys are shown once, at creation, and stored hashed.

posts.title: Domain health checks
posts.markdown:
Each domain now shows whether its SPF, DKIM and DMARC records are right, and tells you the exact record to fix when one is not.

## Changed

- Checks re-run every hour and email you when a record breaks.
